tenant_id_var: ContextVar[str] = ContextVar("tenant_id_var")

router = APIRouter(prefix="/webhooks/deliveries")

    delivery_id: str,
    delivery_store: WebhookDeliveryStore = Depends(get_delivery_store),

    current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user)
):

    if not delivery:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Webhook delivery not found")

    tenant_id_var.set(delivery.tenant_id)

diagnosis: The webhook replay endpoint loads the recorded delivery and sets tenant_id_var to delivery.tenant_id before verifying whether current_user belongs to that tenant. An authenticated attacker can replay and trigger webhooks belonging to any other tenant, exfiltrating payload signatures and tampering with event delivery queues.

corrected_code:
from contextvars import ContextVar
from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException

tenant_id_var: ContextVar[str] = ContextVar("tenant_id_var")

router = APIRouter(prefix="/webhooks/deliveries")

@router.post("/{delivery_id}/replay")
async def replay_webhook_delivery(
    delivery_id: str,
    delivery_store: WebhookDeliveryStore = Depends(get_delivery_store),
    dispatcher: WebhookDispatcher = Depends(get_webhook_dispatcher),
    current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user)
):
    delivery = await delivery_store.get_delivery(delivery_id)
    if not delivery:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Webhook delivery not found")
    if delivery.tenant_id != current_user.tenant_id and not current_user.is_platform_admin:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Forbidden: user does not have permission to replay webhooks for target tenant")

    tenant_id_var.set(delivery.tenant_id)
    result = await dispatcher.dispatch_replay(delivery_id)
    return {"status": "replayed", "delivery_id": delivery_id, "result": result}
